messages.author: 4b4de83a63d1c363
messages.subject: RODBC MySQL connection on shinyapps.io
parts:
RODBC errors on Shinyapps seem commonplace, but I haven't seen anything specifically on MySQL. I'm trying various connection strings to my Amazon RDS-flavored MySQL and not getting anything to work on the server. Any ideas? Here's what I'm using: 

    ch <- odbcDriverConnect('driver=MySQL ODBC 5.2 Driver;server=SERVERNAME;database=DBNAME;uid=USERNAME;pwd=PASSWORD;')
result <- sqlQuery(ch,"SELECT * FROM table;",stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

messages.author: 4b4de83a63d1c363
messages.subject: RODBC MySQL connection on shinyapps.io
parts:
RODBC errors from shinyapps.io seem commonplace, but I haven't found anything on the right way to get MySQL to work with Shinyapps. Trying to use a common driver name, I'm unable to connect to MySQL on Amazon RDS. Here's an example: 

    ch <- odbcDriverConnect('driver={MySQL ODBC 5.2 Driver};server=SERVERNAME;database=DBNAME;uid=USERNAME;pwd=PASSWORD;')
    result <- sqlQuery(ch,"SELECT * FROM table;",stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

The error I'm getting is first argument is not an open RODBC channel
What DSN should I be using to connect to MySQL?
